desc: Read the integers N and K from standard input.
Read the three sequences A, B, and C.
Sort A, B, and C in descending order.
Slice A, B, and C to keep only the first M elements.
Initialize an empty list `values` and iterate through all triplets (i, j, k) from 0 to M-1.
For each triplet, compute $A[i]*B[j] + B[j]*C[k] + C[k]*A[i]$ and append to `values`.
Print the element at index K-1.
Write the final Python code to stdin/stdout.
Run the code against the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
